about: Every difference coherence.patch may make to what tree-sitter-typescript 0.23.2 reads, by construct. compare.mjs parses its corpus with the stock and the patched parsers and fails on any region of difference no entry here allows. An entry allows a region when the region is of its kind (improvement: the stock parser errs there and the patched one does not; regression: the other way about; both err: each errs, differently; reshape: neither errs), in one of its dialects, and overlaps a node its query captures as @construct in the tree of its side. Each entry must show in every case it names, in each of its dialects, so none outlives the patch. Keyed by construct and case name, never by byte offset, so the corpus may grow. No entry allows a token renamed: a leaf of the patched trees that is no type of its own spelling, or is named and spelled as one of the stock grammar's tokens, must be read as the stock trees read that spelling somewhere in the corpus, inside an improvement's region as anywhere else. An entry's tokens lists such a reading it brings ({text, type, named}), allowed only inside its own regions, and each must show there.
